title: Resilience
learning_outcomes: Explain resilience and resources in the context of resilience.
Compare and distinguish actionable stressors in the context of resilience.
Apply social support in the context of resilience.
Evaluate and justify decisions about recovery in the context of resilience.

lessons.title: Resilience and resources
lessons.outcome: Explain resilience and resources in the context of resilience.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving resilience and resources; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional recovery plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain resilience and resources from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of resilience and resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Actionable stressors
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish actionable stressors in the context of resilience.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving actionable stressors; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional recovery plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain actionable stressors from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of actionable stressors; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Social support
lessons.outcome: Apply social support in the context of resilience.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving social support; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional recovery plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain social support from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of social support; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Recovery
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about recovery in the context of resilience.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving recovery; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional recovery plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain recovery from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of recovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of resilience and resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of actionable stressors; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of social support; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of recovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
